# Public UTF-8 replacement fixture

The public Edict application build compiles actual bounded flat-text replacement
with text/replacement UTF-8 validation, prefix character-boundary checks and
no-op refusal. Its independently accepted package/report bytes are retained
unchanged as hex. `provenance.json` records the producer, selected checked
provider, raw hashes and domain-separated package pin.

The authored lawpack separates the constant helper's 64-step cost template
from the operation's 8 Mi-step ceiling. The earlier declarations reuse the
operation ceiling as the helper cost and fail reviewed direct-scan accounting.
The retained source selects the manifest emitted by the public lawpack build.

Reproduction requires the selected producer and checked provider, this authored
lawpack document and source, and the standard application manifest shape from
Jedit's `edict/replace-range`. Build the lawpack first, then the application.
The fixture uses the legacy publication with the promoted components recorded
in provenance. It does not establish the strict public helper/read routes,
final pinned Docker proof, persistent
rope editing, atomic effects or recovery.
